name: Anser Super Wave Skip
author: SarakaUnciv
description:
This mod let you [[]#ffff00]hold down[[]] wave skip keybind to skip wave with[[]#ff8000]No condition[[]]
	And if you [[]#ffff00]hold down[[]] boost keybind while [[]#ffff00]hold down[[]] skip wave you will [[]#00ff00]gain[[]] 5 min of time insted [[]#00ffff]configurable[[]]
	
	Hold down speed is [[]#00ffff]configurable in game setting[[]] default to [[]#00ffff]15 frame[[]]
	Hold down speed is scale with [[]#ffff00]FPS[[]]
	Example setting of [[]#00ffff]10 frame[[]] and [[]#ffff00]40 FPS[[]] will let you skip 4 wave per second
